```{r look at all annual NEE data }

sites_long <- read.csv(file.path('data', 'long_term_ec_sites.csv'))
rm_years   <- read.csv(file.path('data', 'years_to_remove.csv'))

source(file.path("scripts", "00_functions.R"))
df_file_structure <- get_rawflux_file_structure(dir_rawdata)

a_YY_all <- data.frame(site_ID=character(), TIMESTAMP=integer(), NEE_VUT_REF=double(), 
                       GPP_VUT_REF=double(), RECO_VUT_REF=double(), 
                       GPP_NT_VUT_REF=double(), RECO_NT_VUT_REF=double(), 
                       GPP_DT_VUT_REF=double(), RECO_DT_VUT_REF=double())
#
sites_long$nyear <- 0
#
for (i in 1:nrow(sites_long)) {
  # i = 20
  print(i)
  site_ID <- sites_long$site_ID[i]
  print(site_ID)
  folder <- unlist(df_file_structure$folders[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]])
  YYfile <- df_file_structure$YYfiles[df_file_structure$sources == sites_long$source[i]]
  a_YY <- read.csv(folder[grepl(pattern=paste0(site_ID, YYfile), folder)])
  a_YY[a_YY==-9999] <- NA
  #
  a_YY_good <- a_YY %>% filter(!TIMESTAMP %in% rm_years$years[rm_years$site_ID==site_ID])
  sites_long$nyear[i] <- sum(!is.na(a_YY_good$NEE_VUT_REF))
  #
  # plot(a_YY_good$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_good$NEE_VUT_REF, main=site_ID)
  # plot(a_YY_good$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_good$GPP_NT_VUT_REF, main=site_ID)
  # plot(a_YY_good$TIMESTAMP, a_YY_good$RECO_NT_VUT_REF, main=site_ID)
  
  # correct GPP
  if ("GPP_NT_VUT_REF" %in% names(a_YY_good)) {
    idx <- is.na(a_YY_good$GPP_NT_VUT_REF) & !is.na(a_YY_good$RECO_NT_VUT_REF) & !is.na(a_YY_good$NEE_VUT_REF)   
    a_YY_good$GPP_NT_VUT_REF[idx] <- a_YY_good$RECO_NT_VUT_REF[idx] - a_YY_good$NEE_VUT_REF[idx]
  }
  if ("GPP_DT_VUT_REF" %in% names(a_YY)) {
    idx <- is.na(a_YY_good$GPP_DT_VUT_REF) & !is.na(a_YY_good$RECO_DT_VUT_REF) & !is.na(a_YY_good$NEE_VUT_REF)         
    a_YY_good$GPP_DT_VUT_REF[idx] <- a_YY_good$RECO_DT_VUT_REF[idx] - a_YY_good$NEE_VUT_REF[idx]
  }
  
  #
  if (sites_long$NEEpartition[i] == 'DT') {
    df <- a_YY_good[, c("TIMESTAMP", "NEE_VUT_REF", "GPP_DT_VUT_REF", "RECO_DT_VUT_REF")]
  } else {
    df <- a_YY_good[, c("TIMESTAMP", "NEE_VUT_REF", "GPP_NT_VUT_REF", "RECO_NT_VUT_REF")]
  }
  names(df)[3:4] <- c("GPP_VUT_REF", "RECO_VUT_REF")

  # remove unreasonable GPP and RECO. 
  df[df$GPP_VUT_REF < 10 | is.na(df$GPP_VUT_REF), 3:4] <- NA
  
  if ("GPP_NT_VUT_REF" %in% names(a_YY_good)) {
    df$GPP_NT_VUT_REF <- a_YY_good$GPP_NT_VUT_REF
    df$RECO_NT_VUT_REF <- a_YY_good$RECO_NT_VUT_REF
  } else {
    if ("GPP_DT_VUT_REF" %in% names(a_YY)) {
      df$GPP_NT_VUT_REF <- a_YY_good$GPP_DT_VUT_REF
      df$RECO_NT_VUT_REF <- a_YY_good$RECO_DT_VUT_REF      
    } else {
      df$GPP_NT_VUT_REF <- NA
      df$RECO_NT_VUT_REF <- NA
    }
  }

  if ("GPP_DT_VUT_REF" %in% names(a_YY)) {
    df$GPP_DT_VUT_REF <- a_YY_good$GPP_DT_VUT_REF
    df$RECO_DT_VUT_REF <- a_YY_good$RECO_DT_VUT_REF
  } else {
    if ("GPP_NT_VUT_REF" %in% names(a_YY)) {
      df$GPP_DT_VUT_REF <- a_YY_good$GPP_NT_VUT_REF
      df$RECO_DT_VUT_REF <- a_YY_good$RECO_NT_VUT_REF       
    } else {
      df$GPP_DT_VUT_REF <- NA
      df$RECO_DT_VUT_REF <- NA      
    }
  }
  
  # adding CO2 concentration
  if ('CO2_F_MDS' %in% names(a_YY_good)) {
    df$CO2_F_MDS <- a_YY_good$CO2_F_MDS
  } else {
    df$CO2_F_MDS <- NA
  }
  #
  a_YY_all <- rbind(a_YY_all, data.frame(site_ID=site_ID, df))
}
```

```{r moving window for decadal carbon flux trend analysis}
library(librarian)
shelf(lme4, ggplot2, tidyverse, lmerTest)

# read files
sites_long <- read.csv(file.path('data', 'long_term_ec_sites.csv'))
a_YY_all <- read.csv(file.path("data", "a_YY_all.csv"))
#
if (!'category' %in% names(a_YY_all)) {
  a_YY_all <- a_YY_all %>% left_join(sites_long[, c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "category", "NEEpartition")], by = "site_ID")
}

# get trends using local regressions
window_size = 15

# try these without intervals
NEEtrend_all <- data.frame()
# using all sites or sites within certain category. 
climate_vegs <- c('cold_evergreen_forest', 'cold_deciduous_forest', 'cold_non_forest', 'dry', 'wet-warm')

for (climate_veg in climate_vegs) {
  NEEtrend <- data.frame(year_mid=integer(), nsite = integer(),
            Tlm=double(), plm=double(), Tlmlow=double(), Tlmup=double(), 
            Tlmer=double(), plmer=double(), Tlmerlow=double(), Tlmerup=double())  
  #
  if (climate_veg == 'cold_evergreen_forest') {
    data <- a_YY_all %>%   
      filter(IGBP %in% c('ENF', 'EBF') & category == "cold")
  } else if (climate_veg == 'cold_deciduous_forest') {
    data <- a_YY_all %>%  
      filter(IGBP %in% c('DBF', 'DNF', 'MF') & category == "cold")
  } else if (climate_veg == 'cold_non_forest') {
    data <- a_YY_all %>%  
      filter(!IGBP %in% c('ENF', 'EBF', 'DBF', 'DNF', 'MF') & category == "cold") 
  } else if (climate_veg == 'dry') {
    data <- a_YY_all %>% filter(category == 'dry')
  } else if (climate_veg == 'wet-warm') {
    data <- a_YY_all %>% filter(category == 'wet')
  }
  
  # data <- a_YY_all %>% filter(category == 'cold')
  
  #
  year_start <- min(data$TIMESTAMP)
  year_end <- max(data$TIMESTAMP)

  #
  for (iwindow in year_start:(year_end - window_size + 1)) {
    print(iwindow)
    subdata <- data %>% filter(between(TIMESTAMP, iwindow, iwindow + window_size - 1))   
    # this part can be adjusted, the part about window_size
    site_ID_selected <- subdata %>% group_by(site_ID) %>% 
      summarise(nyear = max(TIMESTAMP) - min(TIMESTAMP) + 1) %>% 
      filter(nyear >= min(window_size - 2, 10)) %>% pull(site_ID) 
    
    if (length(site_ID_selected) <= 5) {
      next
    }
    subdata <- subdata %>% filter(site_ID %in% site_ID_selected)
    mod_lm <- lm(data=subdata, NEE_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + site_ID)
    # print(summary(mod_lm))
    mod_lmer <- lmer(data=subdata, NEE_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + (1 | site_ID))
    # print(summary(mod_lmer))
    NEEtrend[iwindow-year_start, 1] <- iwindow + (window_size - 1) / 2
    NEEtrend[iwindow-year_start, 2] <- length(site_ID_selected)
    NEEtrend[iwindow-year_start, 3:4] <- summary(mod_lm)$coefficients[2,c(1,4)]
    NEEtrend[iwindow-year_start, 5:6] <- confint(mod_lm)[2, 1:2]
    NEEtrend[iwindow-year_start, 7:8] <- summary(mod_lmer)$coefficients[2,c(1,5)]
    NEEtrend[iwindow-year_start, 9:10] <- confint(mod_lmer, parm = "beta_", method = "profile")[2,1:2]
  }
  
  # try these with intervals
  # ggplot(data = NEEtrend, aes(x=year_mid, y = Tlm)) +
  #   geom_line(col = 'red') +
  # #  geom_line(aes(x=year_mid, y = Tlmer), col = 'green') +
  #  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Tlmlow, ymax=Tlmup)) +
  #   geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  #   lims(x=c(2000, 2020)) +
  #   theme_classic()
  
  #-----------
  p1 <- ggplot(data = NEEtrend, aes(x=year_mid, y = Tlmer)) +
    geom_line(col = 'green') +
    geom_point(col = 'green') +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Tlmerlow, ymax=Tlmerup)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    lims(x=c(2000, 2020)) +
    labs(title = climate_veg) +
    theme_classic()
  print(p1)
  
  # merge them together
  NEEtrend_all <- bind_rows(NEEtrend_all, data.frame(climate_veg = climate_veg, NEEtrend))
}

# write.csv(data.frame(window = window_size, NEEtrend_all), file = file.path('data', 'NEEtrend.csv'), row.names = F)
```

```{r GPP and ER trends}
library(librarian)
shelf(lme4, ggplot2, tidyverse, lmerTest)
# 
if (!'category' %in% names(a_YY_all)) {
  a_YY_all <- a_YY_all %>% left_join(sites_long[, c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "category")], by = "site_ID")
}

# get trends using local regression of 15 years, 13 years, and 10 years
window_size = 15

GPPtrend_all <- data.frame()
ERtrend_all <- data.frame()
# using all sites or sites within certain category. 
climate_vegs <- c('cold_evergreen_forest', 'cold_deciduous_forest', 'cold_non_forest', 'dry', 'wet-warm')

for (climate_veg in climate_vegs) {
  NEEtrend <- data.frame(year_mid=integer(), nsite = integer(),
            Tlm=double(), plm=double(), Tlmlow=double(), Tlmup=double(), 
            Tlmer=double(), plmer=double(), Tlmerlow=double(), Tlmerup=double())  
  #
  if (climate_veg == 'cold_evergreen_forest') {
    data <- a_YY_all %>%   
      filter(IGBP %in% c('ENF', 'EBF') & category == "cold")
  } else if (climate_veg == 'cold_deciduous_forest') {
    data <- a_YY_all %>%  
      filter(IGBP %in% c('DBF', 'DNF', 'MF') & category == "cold")
  } else if (climate_veg == 'cold_non_forest') {
    data <- a_YY_all %>%  
      filter(!IGBP %in% c('ENF', 'EBF', 'DBF', 'DNF', 'MF') & category == "cold") 
  } else if (climate_veg == 'dry') {
    data <- a_YY_all %>% filter(category == 'dry')
  } else if (climate_veg == 'wet-warm') {
    data <- a_YY_all %>% filter(category == 'wet')
  }

  # data <- a_YY_all %>% filter(category == 'cold')
  
  year_start <- min(data$TIMESTAMP)
  year_end <- max(data$TIMESTAMP)
  
  # try these without intervals
  GPPtrend <- data.frame(year_mid=integer(), nsite = integer(),
              Tlm=double(), plm=double(), Tlmlow=double(), Tlmup=double(), 
              Tlmer=double(), plmer=double(), Tlmerlow=double(), Tlmerup=double())
  #
  ERtrend <- data.frame(year_mid=integer(), nsite = integer(),
              Tlm=double(), plm=double(), Tlmlow=double(), Tlmup=double(), 
              Tlmer=double(), plmer=double(), Tlmerlow=double(), Tlmerup=double())
  #
  for (iwindow in year_start:(year_end - window_size + 1)) {
    print(iwindow)
    subdata <- data %>% filter(between(TIMESTAMP, iwindow, iwindow + window_size - 1))   
    # this part can be adjusted, the part about window_size
    site_ID_selected <- subdata %>% group_by(site_ID) %>% 
      summarise(nyear = max(TIMESTAMP) - min(TIMESTAMP) + 1) %>% 
      filter(nyear >= min(window_size - 2, 10)) %>% pull(site_ID) 
    
    if (length(site_ID_selected) <= 5 | iwindow < 1995) next
    
    subdata <- subdata %>% filter(site_ID %in% site_ID_selected) %>% filter(GPP_DT_VUT_REF < 5000 &  RECO_DT_VUT_REF < 5000) # remove abnormal values. 
    
    # Are they robust to DT and NT partition methods? 
    #### GPP trends first, GPP_VUT_REF, GPP_DT_VUT_REF, GPP_NT_VUT_REF
    if (setequal(unique(subdata$NEEpartition), c("NT", "DT"))) { 
      mod_lm <- lm(data=subdata, GPP_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + site_ID + NEEpartition)
      mod_lmer <- lmer(data=subdata, GPP_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + (1 | site_ID) + (1 | NEEpartition))      
    } else {
      mod_lm <- lm(data=subdata, GPP_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + site_ID)
      mod_lmer <- lmer(data=subdata, GPP_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + (1 | site_ID))      
    }
    # print(summary(mod_lmer))
    GPPtrend[iwindow-year_start, 1] <- iwindow + (window_size - 1) / 2
    GPPtrend[iwindow-year_start, 2] <- length(site_ID_selected)
    GPPtrend[iwindow-year_start, 3:4] <- summary(mod_lm)$coefficients[2,c(1,4)]
    GPPtrend[iwindow-year_start, 5:6] <- confint(mod_lm)[2, 1:2]
    GPPtrend[iwindow-year_start, 7:8] <- summary(mod_lmer)$coefficients[2,c(1,5)]
    GPPtrend[iwindow-year_start, 9:10] <- confint(mod_lmer, parm = "beta_", method = "profile")[2,1:2]
    
    #### ER trends second
    if (setequal(unique(subdata$NEEpartition), c("NT", "DT"))) { 
      mod_lm <- lm(data=subdata, RECO_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + site_ID + NEEpartition)
      # print(summary(mod_lm))
      mod_lmer <- lmer(data=subdata, RECO_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + (1 | site_ID) + (1 | NEEpartition))
      # print(summary(mod_lmer))
    } else {
      mod_lm <- lm(data=subdata, RECO_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + site_ID)
      mod_lmer <- lmer(data=subdata, RECO_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + (1 | site_ID))
    }
    ERtrend[iwindow-year_start, 1] <- iwindow + (window_size - 1) / 2
    ERtrend[iwindow-year_start, 2] <- length(site_ID_selected)
    ERtrend[iwindow-year_start, 3:4] <- summary(mod_lm)$coefficients[2,c(1,4)]
    ERtrend[iwindow-year_start, 5:6] <- confint(mod_lm)[2, 1:2]
    ERtrend[iwindow-year_start, 7:8] <- summary(mod_lmer)$coefficients[2,c(1,5)]
    ERtrend[iwindow-year_start, 9:10] <- confint(mod_lmer, parm = "beta_", method = "profile")[2,1:2]
  }
  
  # # try these with intervals
  # ggplot(data = GPPtrend, aes(x=year_mid, y = Tlm)) +
  #   geom_line(col = 'red') +
  # #  geom_line(aes(x=year_mid, y = Tlm), col = 'green') +
  #  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Tlmlow, ymax=Tlmup)) +
  #   geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
  #   lims(x=c(2000, 2020)) +
  #   theme_classic()
  
  #-----------
p2 <- ggplot(data = GPPtrend, aes(x=year_mid, y = Tlmer)) +
    geom_line(col = 'green') +
    geom_point(col = 'green') +
   geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Tlmerlow, ymax=Tlmerup)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    lims(x=c(2000, 2020), y=c(-25, 30)) +
    labs(title = climate_veg, x = 'Mid-year of moving window', y = 'GPPTrend') +
    theme_classic()
  print(p2)
  
p3 <- ggplot(data = ERtrend, aes(x=year_mid, y = Tlmer)) +
    geom_line(col = 'green') +
    geom_point(col = 'green') +
   geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Tlmerlow, ymax=Tlmerup)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
    lims(x=c(2000, 2020), y=c(-25, 30)) +
    labs(title = climate_veg, x = 'Mid-year of moving window', y = 'ERTrend') +
    theme_classic()
  print(p3)
  
  # merge them together
  GPPtrend_all <- bind_rows(GPPtrend_all, data.frame(climate_veg = climate_veg, GPPtrend))
  ERtrend_all <- bind_rows(ERtrend_all, data.frame(climate_veg = climate_veg, ERtrend))
}
```

```{r GPP and ER trends, daytime or nighttime dominated}
              Tlmer=double(), plmer=double(), Tlmerlow=double(), Tlmerup=double())

              Tlmer=double(), plmer=double(), Tlmerlow=double(), Tlmerup=double())
  #
  for (iwindow in year_start:(year_end - window_size + 1)) {
    print(iwindow)
    subdata <- data %>% filter(between(TIMESTAMP, iwindow, iwindow + window_size - 1))   
    # this part can be adjusted, the part about window_size
    site_ID_selected <- subdata %>% group_by(site_ID) %>% 
      summarise(nyear = max(TIMESTAMP) - min(TIMESTAMP) + 1) %>% 
      filter(nyear >= min(window_size - 2, 10)) %>% pull(site_ID) 
    
    if (length(site_ID_selected) <= 5 | iwindow < 1995) next
    
    subdata <- subdata %>% filter(site_ID %in% site_ID_selected) %>% filter(GPP_DT_VUT_REF < 5000 &  RECO_DT_VUT_REF < 5000) # remove abnormal values. 
    
    # Are they robust to DT and NT partition methods? 
    #### GPP trends first, GPP_DT_VUT_REF , GPP_NT_VUT_REF
    ## Partitioning methods were not in the model. 
    mod_lm <- lm(data=subdata, GPP_NT_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + site_ID)
    mod_lmer <- lmer(data=subdata, GPP_NT_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + (1 | site_ID))

    # print(summary(mod_lmer))
    GPPtrend[iwindow-year_start, 1] <- iwindow + (window_size - 1) / 2
    GPPtrend[iwindow-year_start, 2] <- length(site_ID_selected)
    GPPtrend[iwindow-year_start, 3:4] <- summary(mod_lm)$coefficients[2,c(1,4)]
    GPPtrend[iwindow-year_start, 5:6] <- confint(mod_lm)[2, 1:2]
    GPPtrend[iwindow-year_start, 7:8] <- summary(mod_lmer)$coefficients[2,c(1,5)]
    GPPtrend[iwindow-year_start, 9:10] <- confint(mod_lmer, parm = "beta_", method = "profile")[2,1:2]
    
    #### ER trends second: RECO_DT_VUT_REF, RECO_NT_VUT_REF
    mod_lm <- lm(data=subdata, RECO_NT_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + site_ID)
    mod_lmer <- lmer(data=subdata, RECO_NT_VUT_REF ~ TIMESTAMP + (1 | site_ID))
    #
    ERtrend[iwindow-year_start, 1] <- iwindow + (window_size - 1) / 2
    ERtrend[iwindow-year_start, 2] <- length(site_ID_selected)
    ERtrend[iwindow-year_start, 3:4] <- summary(mod_lm)$coefficients[2,c(1,4)]
    ERtrend[iwindow-year_start, 5:6] <- confint(mod_lm)[2, 1:2]
    ERtrend[iwindow-year_start, 7:8] <- summary(mod_lmer)$coefficients[2,c(1,5)]
    ERtrend[iwindow-year_start, 9:10] <- confint(mod_lmer, parm = "beta_", method = "profile")[2,1:2]
  }
  
  #-----------------------------------Look at the results------------------------
  p2 <- ggplot(data = GPPtrend, aes(x=year_mid, y = Tlmer)) +
      geom_line(col = 'green') +
      geom_point(col = 'green') +
     geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Tlmerlow, ymax=Tlmerup)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
      lims(x=c(2000, 2020), y=c(-25, 30)) +
      labs(title = climate_veg, x = 'Mid-year of moving window', y = 'GPPTrend') +
      theme_classic()
    print(p2)
    
  p3 <- ggplot(data = ERtrend, aes(x=year_mid, y = Tlmer)) +
      geom_line(col = 'green') +
      geom_point(col = 'green') +
     geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=Tlmerlow, ymax=Tlmerup)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 0) +
      lims(x=c(2000, 2020), y=c(-25, 30)) +
      labs(title = climate_veg, x = 'Mid-year of moving window', y = 'ERTrend') +
      theme_classic()
    print(p3)
    
  # merge them together
  GPPtrend_all <- bind_rows(GPPtrend_all, data.frame(climate_veg = climate_veg, GPPtrend))
  ERtrend_all <- bind_rows(ERtrend_all, data.frame(climate_veg = climate_veg, ERtrend))
}

write.csv(data.frame(method = 'nighttime', GPPtrend_all), file = file.path('data', 'GPPtrend.csv'), row.names = F)
write.csv(data.frame(method = 'nighttime', ERtrend_all), file = file.path('data', 'ERtrend.csv'), row.names = F)
```

```{r use nonlinear trend method}
library(librarian)
shelf(lme4, mgcv)

data <- a_YY_all
data$site_ID <- as.factor(data$site_ID)

mod <- gam(
  NEE_VUT_REF ~ s(TIMESTAMP, k = 10) +       # global smooth trend
       s(TIMESTAMP, site_ID, bs = "fs", k = 3), # site-specific smooth deviations
  data = data,
  method = "REML"
)

gam.check(mod)
# plot(mod, pages = 1, shade = TRUE)

#######get overall trends
tseq <- seq(min(data$TIMESTAMP), max(data$TIMESTAMP), length = 200)

newdat <- data.frame(
  TIMESTAMP = tseq,
  site_ID = data$site_ID[1]   # dummy site
)

Xp <- predict(mod, newdat, type = "lpmatrix")

# remove site-specific smooth contributions
site_cols <- grepl("s\\(TIMESTAMP,site_ID", colnames(Xp))
Xp[, site_cols] <- 0

fit <- Xp %*% coef(mod)

V <- vcov(mod)
se <- sqrt(rowSums((Xp %*% V) * Xp))
ci <- 1.96 * se

df_NEE_nl <- data.frame(YEAR = tseq, NEE = fit, 
                          NEE_low = fit - ci, NEE_up = fit + ci)
ggplot(data = df_NEE_nl, aes(x=YEAR, y=NEE)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = NEE_low, ymax = NEE_up))

##############How to get the first derivative?#################################
# Get derivatives and their confidence intervals
dt <- diff(tseq)
d_fit <- diff(fit) / dt

# midpoints for plotting
t_mid <- (tseq[-1] + tseq[-length(tseq)]) / 2

# CI of derivatives
V <- vcov(mod)

# derivative linear predictor matrix (difference)
Xp_deriv <- Xp
Xp_deriv <- Xp_deriv[-1, ] - Xp_deriv[-nrow(Xp_deriv), ]
Xp_deriv <- Xp_deriv / dt

se_deriv <- sqrt(rowSums((Xp_deriv %*% V) * Xp_deriv))
ci_deriv <- 1.96 * se_deriv

df_trend_nl <- data.frame(YEAR = t_mid, trend = d_fit, 
                    trend_low = d_fit - ci_deriv, trend_up = d_fit + ci_deriv)
ggplot(data = df_trend_nl, aes(x=YEAR, y=trend)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = trend_low, ymax = trend_up)) +
  labs(title = 'Trends')
```

```{r site-level carbon trend results}
library(librarian)
shelf(lme4, ggplot2, tidyverse, lmerTest, trend, ggpubr)
#
# a function to calculate sens slope
cal_sens_slope <- function(x) {
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  # x <- scale(x)
  return(as.numeric(sens.slope(x)[c(1,3)]))
}

#
if (!'category' %in% names(a_YY_all)) {
  a_YY_all <- a_YY_all %>% left_join(sites_long[, c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "category")], by = "site_ID")
}

# get trends using local regressions
window_size = 15

# using all sites or sites within certain category. 
# subsites_long <- sites_long %>% filter(category == 'wet')

CarbonTrend <- data.frame(site_ID = character(), year_mid=integer(), 
                     NEE = double(), GPP = double(), ER = double(), 
                     NEEtrend = double(), NEEtrendp = double(), 
                     GPPtrend = double(), GPPtrendp = double(), 
                     ERtrend = double(), ERtrendp = double())
#
id = 1
for (i in 1:nrow(sites_long)) {
  data <- a_YY_all %>% filter(site_ID == sites_long$site_ID[i])

  nwindow = max(nrow(data) - window_size + 1, 1)
  for (iwindow in 1:nwindow) {
    a_YY_sub <- data[iwindow:(min(nrow(data), window_size) + iwindow - 1), ]
    if (sum(!is.na(a_YY_sub$NEE_VUT_REF)) > 5) {
      CarbonTrend[id, 1] <- sites_long$site_ID[i]
      CarbonTrend[id, 2] <- round(mean(a_YY_sub$TIMESTAMP, na.rm=T))
      CarbonTrend[id, 3] <- mean(a_YY_sub$NEE_VUT_REF, na.rm=T)
      CarbonTrend[id, 4] <- mean(a_YY_sub$GPP_VUT_REF, na.rm=T)
      CarbonTrend[id, 5] <- mean(a_YY_sub$RECO_VUT_REF, na.rm=T)
      CarbonTrend[id, 6:7] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$NEE_VUT_REF)
      if (sum(!is.na(a_YY_sub$GPP_VUT_REF)) > 5) {
        CarbonTrend[id, 8:9] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$GPP_VUT_REF)
      }
      if (sum(!is.na(a_YY_sub$RECO_VUT_REF)) > 5) {
        CarbonTrend[id, 10:11] <- cal_sens_slope(a_YY_sub$RECO_VUT_REF)
      }      
      #
      id = id + 1      
    }
  }
}

if (!'category' %in% names(CarbonTrend)) {
  CarbonTrend <- CarbonTrend %>% left_join(sites_long[, c("site_ID", "IGBP", "Climate.class", "category")], by = "site_ID")
}
```

```{r check autocorrelation in carbon trend}

# "BE-Vie", "CH-Dav", "DE-Tha", "FI-Hyy", "US-Ha1"
CarbonTrendSite <- CarbonTrend %>% filter(site_ID == "US-Ha1") %>% arrange(year_mid)
acf(CarbonTrendSite$NEEtrend)  # 1-2 orders of autocorrelation
acf(CarbonTrendSite$GPPtrend)
acf(CarbonTrendSite$ERtrend)

CarbonTrendSite$NEEtrend_prev <- lag(CarbonTrendSite$NEEtrend, 1)
CarbonTrendSite$NEEtrend_prev2 <- lag(CarbonTrendSite$NEEtrend, 2)
CarbonTrendSite$GPPtrend_prev <- lag(CarbonTrendSite$GPPtrend, 1)
CarbonTrendSite$ERtrend_prev <- lag(CarbonTrendSite$ERtrend, 1)

summary(lm(data = CarbonTrendSite, NEEtrend ~ NEEtrend_prev))
mod_prev <- lm(data = CarbonTrendSite, NEEtrend ~ GPPtrend + ERtrend + NEEtrend_prev )
acf(residuals(mod_prev))
summary(mod_prev)

# summary(lm(data = CarbonTrendSite, NEEtrend ~ GPPtrend + ERtrend + NEEtrend_prev +  GPPtrend_prev + ERtrend_prev))  
library(nlme)

mod_gls <- gls(NEEtrend ~ GPPtrend + ERtrend,
    correlation = corAR1(form = ~ year_mid), data = CarbonTrendSite)
acf(residuals(mod_gls))
summary(mod_gls)
coef(mod_gls)

#               Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
# (Intercept)    16.4453     6.4946   2.532   0.0298 *  
# GPPtrend       -0.7850     0.3145  -2.496   0.0317 *  
# ERtrend         1.4798     0.4942   2.994   0.0135 *  
# NEEtrend_prev   1.0077     0.1591   6.335 8.51e-05 ***

CarbonTrendSite$NEEtrend_d <- CarbonTrendSite$NEEtrend - CarbonTrendSite$NEEtrend_prev
CarbonTrendSite$GPPtrend_d <- CarbonTrendSite$GPPtrend - lag(CarbonTrendSite$GPPtrend, 1)
CarbonTrendSite$ERtrend_d <- CarbonTrendSite$ERtrend - lag(CarbonTrendSite$ERtrend, 1)

summary(lm(data = CarbonTrendSite, NEEtrend_d ~ GPPtrend + ERtrend))  # + NEEtrend_prev2
mod_diff <- lm(data = CarbonTrendSite, NEEtrend_d ~ GPPtrend_d + ERtrend_d)
summary(mod_diff)  
acf(residuals(mod_diff))

acf(CarbonTrendSite$NEEtrend_d[2:nrow(CarbonTrendSite)])   # if we do differences, the autocorrelation disappears!
```
